Great bar for food, drinks and sports
Apr 2019 • Family
We discovered this by chance and I don’t know why it isn’t busier. Has all the big sports on show, AFL, super rugby, league, northern hemisphere rugby. Excellent bar style food, burgers, sausages chips etc and it’s right on the beach. Just left of the huge My Hành restaurant. The front balcony has stunning views along the My Khe beach. There’s a pool table, it’s spotlessly clean with excellent toilets. The best bar I found in Da Nang after staying here a month. And to top it all off prices are cheaper than other locations

Great bar, good beer!
Jan 2019 • Couples
This place is great - good for a beer and something to eat. You can sit outside looking out over the beach and the sea or over the street or you can sit inside. It is up one level - there is a lift. The staff are delightful. You can watch sport if you want.Beer (cans, bottles and on tap) is about 40,000 VND, a very nice toasted ham, cheese and tomato sandwich is 40,000 VND so a beer and sarnie won't break the bank. Fish and chips is excellent - plenty of fish and cost 180,000 VND but well worth it. Some Aussies but quite a mix including a few locals.Great place to chill out.

Wanted to hear an Aussie voice, would I/ Absolutely.....
Nov 2018 • Solo
A real taste of home in this super beach-front bar and restaurant. Several big screens and in season, all the football and rugby any Aussie could want. For those who don't mind a lot of dry land diving, there's also the EPL head ball and a bit of footwork, soccer isn't it? The spacious balcony over looks miles of beach and a cool breeze made for an enjoyable afternoon of cold beers and Aussie talk with "Bear" who hails from Sydney. Billabong clearly had done some serious research and has an active pool competition on a very good looking table with plenty of room for other patrons to view one or more of the big screens. A true Aussie experience so far from home, great job Bear and mates!
